title: Refute: find signals, try to kill them, keep what survives
description:
Refute is an open-source framework where agents try to break scientific claims before anyone believes them. Claims are pre-registered and locked with SHA-256 hashes, attacked by deterministic falsification tests and a blind holdout, and reported in reproducible evidence dossiers. Agents propose; deterministic tests decide. A claim is never proven: it only survives, or it does not.

Version 0.5.0 closes v0.5 Stronger tests as WEAKENED: a TESS battery that says INCONCLUSIVE when a test could not have failed, measured against the v0.4 battery on the same curves. Fewer spurious signals survive and many more planets end INCONCLUSIVE; the failed targets and the structural findings are reported in the release notes and in calibration/v0.5/ (method_status: not_validated). Refute reports verdicts only, never a new planet. The closing record of v0.5 is https://github.com/klucilla/refute/blob/v0.5.0/calibration/v0.5/results/closing-record.md. After v0.5, three correction rounds closed as not approved (v0.5.1: https://github.com/klucilla/refute/blob/v0.5.0/docs/validation/v0.5.1/closing-record.md; v0.5.2: https://github.com/klucilla/refute/blob/v0.5.0/docs/validation/v0.5.2/closing-record.md; v0.5.3: https://github.com/klucilla/refute/blob/v0.5.0/docs/validation/v0.5.3/closing-record.md), and v0.5.4 (information checks) closed (https://github.com/klucilla/refute/blob/v0.5.0/docs/validation/v0.5.4/h2-stop-report.md). The v0.5 line is paused by the maintainer's decision of 2026-11-13, with no target relaxed and none declared infeasible (https://github.com/klucilla/refute/blob/v0.5.0/docs/validation/v0.5.4/pause-record.md). The v0.4 pilot's dossiers are in https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23898648 and its reproduction inputs in https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23874043.

Every third-party data file, with the record that covers it, is listed in https://github.com/klucilla/refute/blob/v0.5.0/docs/third-party-data.md. No single license covers the archive as a whole.
